徐大相 is Xu Daxiang and 继春 refers to Jia Jichun

Sun Qifeng of Rongcheng was a man of honor and courage. He and Lu Zhengyi of Dingxing, believing Guangdou had served the capital region well, proposed a public collection, and students rushed to contribute.

Sun Qifeng of Rongcheng was a man of honor and courage. He and Lu Zheng of Dingxing, believing Guangdou had served the capital region well, proposed a public collection, and students rushed to contribute.
鹿正 is Lu Zheng; the following 以 means because, not part of the name
He received his jinshi degree in the forty-fourth year of the Wanli reign and served as a courier in the Ministry of Rites.
He received his jinshi degree in the forty-fourth year of the Wanli reign and served as a messenger in the Office of Messengers.
行人 is a Messenger of the Office of Messengers, not a Ministry of Rites courier

Wang Shaohui, vice minister of rites, had long opposed the Donglin faction and was angling for a provincial governorship. Dazhong despised him and submitted a special memorial calling for his removal; Shaohui eventually withdrew on his own.

Wang Shaohui, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, had long opposed the Donglin faction and was angling for a provincial governorship. Dazhong despised him and submitted a special memorial calling for his removal; Shaohui eventually withdrew on his own.
太常少卿 is vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not of rites

During the reigns of Guangzong and Xizong, the outer court relied on Liu Yihuan while An Zhongxing carried out good policies within the palace one after another; Wenyan's behind-the-scenes work contributed greatly.

During the reigns of Guangzong and Xizong, the outer court relied on Liu Yijing while Wang An, from within the palace, carried out good policies within the palace one after another; Wenyan's behind-the-scenes work contributed greatly.
刘一燝 is Liu Yijing; 安居中 means Wang An inside the palace, not a person named An Zhongxing

Now Zhongxian monopolizes power and favor, builds factions, first killed Wang An to terrorize the inner court, then drove out Liu Yihuan, Zhou Jiamo, and Wang Ji to terrorize the outer court, and recently even had three relatives of imperial consorts put to death to terrorize the three palaces.

Now Zhongxian monopolizes power and favor, builds factions, first killed Wang An to terrorize the inner court, then drove out Liu Yijing, Zhou Jiamo, and Wang Ji to terrorize the outer court, and recently even had three relatives of imperial consorts put to death to terrorize the three palaces.
刘一燝 is romanized Liu Yijing

Commander Xu Xianchun, working upward from a fabricated dossier, dragged in Nanxing, Lian, Guangdou, Dazhong, Li Ruoxing, Mao Shilong, Yuan Huazhong, Miu Changqi, Zou Weilian, Deng Mei, Lu Hu'ao, Qian Shijin, Xia Zhiling, Wang Zhicai, Xu Liangyan, Xiong Mingyu, Zhou Chaorui, Huang Longguang, Gu Dazhang, Li Sancai, Hui Shiyang, Shi Tiande, Huang Zhengbin, and countless others. Lian, Guangdou, Dazhong, Huazhong, Chaorui, and Dazhang were charged with accepting bribes from Yang Hao and Xiong Tingbi—Dazhong's share set at three thousand taels—and by forged edict all were arrested and sent to the imperial prison.

Commander Xu Xianchun, working upward from a fabricated dossier, dragged in Nanxing, Lian, Guangdou, Dazhong, Li Ruoxing, Mao Shilong, Yuan Huazhong, Miu Changqi, Zou Weilian, Deng Mei, Lu Hua'ao, Qian Shijin, Xia Zhiling, Wang Zhicai, Xu Liangyan, Xiong Mingyu, Zhou Chaorui, Huang Longguang, Gu Dazhang, Li Sancai, Hui Shiyang, Shi Tiande, Huang Zhengbin, and countless others. Lian, Guangdou, Dazhong, Huazhong, Chaorui, and Dazhang were charged with accepting bribes from Yang Hao and Xiong Tingbi—Dazhong's share set at three thousand taels—and by forged edict all were arrested and sent to the imperial prison.
卢化鰲 is Lu Hua'ao; the hua syllable was garbled
Dazhong was posthumously honored as Minister of Ceremonies with the posthumous name Loyal and Upright, and one of his sons was granted an official appointment.
Dazhong was posthumously honored as Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with the posthumous name Loyal and Upright, and one of his sons was granted an official appointment.
太常卿 heads the Court of Imperial Sacrifices

Later, together with supervising secretaries and censors including Hui Shiyang and Zuo Guangdou, he fiercely denounced Grand Secretary Shen Huan for colluding with eunuchs to drill troops—a traitor at the Emperor's very side.

Later, together with supervising secretaries and censors including Hui Shiyang and Zuo Guangdou, he fiercely denounced Grand Secretary Shen Hong for colluding with eunuchs to drill troops—a traitor at the Emperor's very side.
Huan submitted a memorial in self-defense.
Hong submitted a memorial in self-defense.
沈纮 is Shen Hong; the given name 纮 reads Hong
Early in the Chongzhen reign he was posthumously honored as Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official appointment.
Early in the Chongzhen reign he was posthumously honored as Chief Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official appointment.
太仆卿 is the chief minister, not vice minister
Gu Dazhang, courtesy name Bojin, was a native of Changshu.
Gu Dazhang, courtesy name Boqin, was a native of Changshu.
Early in the Chongzhen reign, he was posthumously honored as Chief Minister of Justice, and one son was granted an official appointment.
Early in the Chongzhen reign, he was posthumously honored as Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, and one son was granted an official appointment.
大理卿 heads the Court of Judicial Review

When Wang Ji impeached and removed Xu Dahua, and then submitted a memorial attacking Lady Ke, their clique suspected Ji's memorial had come from Dazhang's hand and hated him for it.
客氏 is Lady Ke, the wet nurse, not a Cui faction
Early in the Chongzhen reign he was posthumously honored as Vice Minister of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official appointment.
Early in the Chongzhen reign he was posthumously honored as Chief Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and one son was granted an official appointment.
太仆卿 is chief minister, not vice minister
